designer.title: I'm a Designer
designer.intro: Design is my way of solving problems and creating experiences that truly matter.

philosophy.title: My Philosophy
philosophy.content: I believe in design as a tool for transformation. My approach centers on deeply understanding people: their needs and aspirations. Every design decision must have a clear purpose backed by research and empathy.

process.title: My Process
process.content: My process is iterative and collaborative. I start with deep research and data analysis. I prototype quickly to validate ideas early. I work closely with developers and users throughout the entire process.

vision.title: My Vision
vision.content: I aspire to create products that genuinely improve people's lives. I want to design experiences so intuitive they go unnoticed. My vision is to democratize access to quality digital experiences.

tools.title: Tools
tools.content: Figma, Sketch, Adobe XD, Principle, Framer. Mastery of interactive prototyping and scalable design systems.

collaboration.title: Collaboration
collaboration.content: Multidisciplinary teamwork. Effective communication with developers, product managers, and stakeholders.

impact.title: Impact
impact.content: Designs that generate measurable results. Focus on user metrics and continuous data-driven improvement.

learning.title: Learning
learning.content: Always exploring new trends, technologies, and methodologies. Design is constantly evolving.

developer.title: I'm a Developer
developer.intro: I build digital products with clean code and scalable architectures.

stack.title: Stack
stack.content: React, TypeScript, Next.js, Node.js. Expert in Supabase, PostgreSQL and serverless architectures.

approach.title: Approach
approach.content: Clean code, rigorous testing, and clear documentation. I prioritize maintainability and scalability in every line.

products.title: Products
products.content: Built complete web platforms from scratch. From MVPs to enterprise systems with thousands of users.

frontend.title: Frontend
frontend.content: Forever curious about React and the JS ecosystem. Reusable components, performance optimization, and smooth UX.

backend.title: Backend
backend.content: RESTful and GraphQL APIs. Supabase expert: auth, real-time, edge functions. Relational and NoSQL databases.

mindset.title: Mindset
mindset.content: Always learning new libraries and frameworks. Web development evolves fast and I love staying current.

delivery.title: Delivery
delivery.content: Code in production is what matters. CI/CD, monitoring, and continuous improvement based on real metrics.
